notes.title: HUGE UPDATE COMING TO FALLEN THREATS
notes.content:
Now the game starts with a tutorial, so if you had problems with the controls on the previous versions now you can get to know them in this tutorial.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637112/92be653bdb0757b64945674a57f20897a638eaad.png[/img]

The graphics have changed a lot!, by this i mean that the sprites now are 16x16 pixels so it looks more "cute" now.

The code and behaviour for the bosses have also changed and now they are more hard!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33637112/63cc8db0b3f2230c74ba6024ea1e23aa959acbba.png[/img]

I will keep updated the game as much as possible adding sword and bows to the game, also i have planned to make more dungeons to explore and add some secret bosses.

notes.title: Fallen Threats coming to Linux!
notes.content:
Now i'm working to bring you Fallen Threats to Linux! There's a lot of tests to do yet, but it will arrive the day.

So be patient please.

And thank you for the support.

-Mario Almaguer.

notes.title: A new update has arrived!
notes.content:
Changelog[16/12/2018]
-The Intro Scene has been colorized.
-The bosses have improved their projectiles.
-The pause menu has been changed.
-The Sword Menu has been changed.
-Some HUD fixes.
-Varius minor abilities bugs have been fixed.
-Now "Fallen Threats" change its color in the menu.
-Sounds have been added to the menus.
-Some fonts have been updated.

notes.title: Fallen Threats has been updated!
notes.content:
Changelog[10/12/2018]
-The Anvil sprite has been changed.
-The limit of the coins has been limited to 99.
-The limit of the potions has been limited to 9.
-The projectile thrower now shoots every 1.5s.
-The abilities now works.
-Now the player walks slower when he pass by a spiderweb.
-The HUD has been Changed.
-The "Stats" and "Options" room has been re-designed.
-The menu to upgrade your attributes has been re-designed.
-The menu to buy swords/axes/knives, has been changed.
-Now you can buy the chest for 33 coins.
-The delay times of abilities have been changed.
-The healthbar of the bosses has been modified.

notes.title: Redesigning some Bosses.
notes.content:
Fallen Threats is improving some Bosses to have better graphics.

You can find more details in my Twitter @Betitoas1 and see the changes that i am making to the game with more detail.
